question: If an electromagnetic wave carries a total energy density $u$, how is this energy distributed between the electric field ($u_E$) and the magnetic field ($u_B$)?

options.A: It is entirely stored in the electric field ($u = u_E$).
options.B: It is entirely stored in the magnetic field ($u = u_B$).
options.D: The ratio depends on the frequency of the wave.
